{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any revenue values are 999999.99 (QA orders)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check if QA orders are in the data
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    print("QA orders found. They will be excluded.")
else:
    print("No QA orders found. Proceeding.")

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded orders (status == 'refunded'):")
print(refunded_orders.head())

# Check how many of them have revenue > 0
print(f"Number of refunded orders with revenue > 0: {refunded_orders['revenue_clean'].gt(0).sum()}")

# Verify that revenue is now numeric and clean
print("First few cleaned revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head(10))"}
